Runic Lightning Gunners are iron dwarves located in Grizzly Hills.

The Runestone of Plague can be found in a shallow pool near the Sepulcher of Knowledge in Maldraxxus. One of five runestones in the area, it represents the values of the House of Plagues.
The Runestone of Constructs can be found near the Sepulcher of Knowledge in Maldraxxus. One of five runestones in the area, it represents the values of the House of Constructs.

Runic Diagram can be found on the corpses of all creatures in Korthia, more likely on rare and rare-elite enemies (for Conquering Korthia), and inside other Relic Fragment-containing lootables around the zone. Turn the item to Archivist Roh-Suir at the Reliquary of Remembrance of Keeper's Respite for 8 Cataloged Research and 4 reputation with the Archivists' Codex.
Runestone Treasure Chests are chests found in Ashenvale, Darkshore, Feralas, Shimmering Expanse, Abyssal Depths, Grizzly Hills, Dire Maul, and Blackfathom Deeps.

__NOTOC__ Runethief Xy'lora is a broker located in Pilgrim's Grace in Zereth Mortis.

Runic Syllables are found on pillars at the Sepulcher of the First Ones in Zereth Mortis. Every rune found will give a stack of Syllabic Recall lasting five minutes, refreshing upon new stacks gained. When all sic runes have been found, the Syntactic Seal can be dispelled and the Syntactic Vault can be accessed.

The Runic Wing drops from Tazenrath in the Burrow of the Faithful in the Forbidden Reach. Obtaining the wing will grant an Arcane Barrier, reducing damage taken and returning damage as well for 10 minutes, as well as leaving you with Tazenrath's Torn Wing.
Rush of Vitality is a Preservation talent for evokers. It is an exclusive choice node with Dreamwalker.
Rupert is an earth elemental located at the Dragonscale Basecamp in the Waking Shores. He is found near Earthmender Narvra.
__NOTOC__ Ruriq is a tuskarr located in the Azure Span. He makes toy boats.
Rusted Coin of the Isles is fished up from pools anywhere on the Dragon Isles. It starts The Great Swog (quest), introducing players to the titular Great Swog.
Rush of Light is a Retribution paladin talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Consecrated Ground.

The Runtish Gronnling was a gronnling companion that was never made available. Its source was listed as "Drop: Your Attitude" during the Warlords beta, but it's unknown what Your Attitude was. This pet no longer exists in the database, as its NPC ID was later reused by Brightpaw.
Runestone Shards is contained in Disturbed Dirt, Icemaw Storage Cache, and Expedition Scout's Pack.
Runic Symbols and their Meaning is sold by Unatos and Giera in Valdrakken for .

Runestalker Runts are shadowstalkers located in the woods of east-central Ardenweald, between the Creeping Hive in the southwest and the Tranquil Pools in the northeast. Some are sleeping under the watch of adult Runestalkers or eating from Runestag carcasses.

Runestalkers are shadowstalkers located in the woods of east-central Ardenweald, between the Creeping Hive in the southwest and the Tranquil Pools in the northeast. They sometimes attack nearby Juvenile Runedeer, while others watch over sleeping Runestalker Runts or are seen eating from Runestag carcasses.
Ryan and Blake were villagers playing tag when Arthas was at a village between the Silver Hand encampment and Strahnbrad. They laughed whenever Arthas was near them.
__NOTOC__ Rwag is an orc rogue trainer located in the Den in the Valley of Trials of Durotar. He doesn't trust the warlock Nartok.
Ruzan is an orc quest giver located in the Valley of Trials in Durotar.
Ruul Eagletalon is a tauren quest giver located at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.
Ruuzel is a naga found on Ruuzel's Isle in Ashenvale. Talen wants the ring Ruuzel possesses.

Ruul Snowhoof is a tauren druid and quest giver located deep in Thistlefur Hold in Ashenvale, where he is seen in Bear Form and being held in a cage by the Thistlefur furbolgs. The furbolgs believe him to be an actual bear and are, for some reason, starving him to death. Ruul asks Horde players to free him and escort him to safety for the quest Freedom to Ruul, and afterward asks them to speak with his sister Yama Snowhoof in Splintertree Post.
__NOTOC__ Rusty Harvest Golem is a harvest golem that can be found in Westfall.
Ruul Onestone is an ogre rare mob found at the Circle of West Binding in the Arathi Highlands. In Classic, he is on a 21 to 32 hour respawn timer.

__NOTOC__ Ruuzlu is an elite sand troll found in Zul'Farrak. He accompanies his comrade and friend, Chief Ukorz Sandscalp. He is the right hand of the chief. He planned to use scarabs, sul'lithuz basilisks, and troll zombies to retake Tanaris for the Sandfury empire.
Ruw is a tauren artisan herbalism trainer located in Camp Mojache in Feralas.
__NOTOC__ Ryosh is a draenei general goods vendor located at the Crash Site in Azuremyst Isle.

Rustler Gloves are a quest reward from Identifying the Brood.

Ruvaef is a Blizzard employee and was an English language In-Game Customer Support Representative and Game Master for the European World of Warcraft community, normally encountered on the EU forums, specifically the [http://forums-en.wow-europe.com/ English WoW forums]. Ruvaef was the "back up" poster when Issuntril was unavailable or on vacation [http://forums.wow-europe.com/thread.html?topicId=17792269&sid=1]. He has been replaced by Celunduil.

Rusty Harpoons would have been an objective of Change of Plans.
Rygna's Lair an area inside the Blackwald in Gilneas. It is the home of the black widow Rygna, the Vilebrood Matriarch.

Ruthless Gladiator is a title awarded for being the highest rated arena team in the battlegroup at the end of Arena Season 10.

It can also be found in front of the stump to the left of the Dented Shovel next to the stairs across from position close to the plots. The watering can is used to treat Parched crops. At with the Tillers, the "Jinyu Princess" Irrigation System can be purchased, which will water a 4x8 plot of crops at once.
Ryal is the daughter of Sarrak and mother of Aggralan, making her the mother-in-law of Thrall and the maternal grandmother of Durak and Rehze. Aggra's wolf, Ryala, is named after Ryal.

Ruun Ghostpaw is a rare pandaren found in Krasarang Wilds. He can be found resting in one of the side chambers on the second floor of the Temple of the Red Crane. Ruun is a Pandarian champion.
__NOTOC__ Ryshelle Brightlock is a blood elf member of the Reliquary first seen on the Crimson Treader and later found near the Court of Bones on the Isle of Thunder.

Ryshan is a pandaren angler found in Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds. Once after delivery of a fish shipment he found Li Li Stormstout who was looking for the spot where Liu Lang had set off from atop Shen-zin Su. He told her that the place is near the Anglers Wharf. He took her to the village by a boat and they were accompanied by a bandicoon that Li Li named after her brother Shisai.

Ryan Shwayder is a Senior Game Designer for World of Warcraft. Ruth Negga is an Ethiopian-Irish actress best known for her portrayals in films such as Capital Letters, Isolation, Breakfast on Pluto, as well as the television shows Criminal Justice, Love/Hate, Misfits and Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. From the whispers of the forest she learned of Malfurion's return and the companion he recently traveled with. "Situation Normal, All F****d Up" Perhaps more commonly, bowdlerized[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bowdlerized] "F" words are used. While in no way a World of Warcraft specific term, it is certainly one of many fitting terms used to describe why something did not go exactly according to plan, e.g: — "Why did you wipe at Ragnaros tonight?" — "Ah, we just had a sons snafu. __NOTOC__ Sab'aoth is a human reagent and poison vendor located at Cosmowrench in the Netherstorm. A former member of the Twilight's Hammer, he has taken a break from battling anyone who would challenge him to write a book on his experiences in the clan while his reagent business gets off the ground.

Saber cats (or sabercats and sabers) are a special type of large fanged cat, similar to the (extinct) sabertooth cats of real world. They come in a variety of colors and have either spotted or striped coats, the striped type being the more common. Night elves carry a special affinity for sabers and use them as mounts, which are available for purchase in Darnassus.

S-A-B-O-T-A-G-E is the fourth part of a quest chain that begins with The Ethereum and ends with Nexus-King Salhadaar.

Saamul is an Alliance restoration or elemental shaman and is one of the possible opponents for Horde in the Faction Champions battle in the Trial of the Crusader raid instance.

S.B.R.B. Prototype 4 is a quest reward from Zombies vs. Super Booster Rocket Boots.
Sabersnout's Cloak is a quest reward from Diplomacy By Another Means and Speaking Their Language.

__NOTOC__ S.A.F.E. Operatives are gnome members of the Survivor Assistance Facilitation Expedition found throughout the Old Dormitory in Dun Morogh where they are fighting off the Crazed Leper Gnomes and tending to the irradiated survivors.

S.A.F.E. Technicians are gnomes found in various areas of uninstanced Gnomeregan. During the quest Decontamination, the Sanitron 500 breaks down and one of the S.A.F.E. Technicians exclaims that "it was my pride and joy". Additionally, there is some flavor text about needing a new job.
S.A.F.E. Officers are gnomes found in the decontamination area of the Gnomish starting experience as well as in New Tinkertown.
The SI:7 Squad Commander is a human SI:7 agent found at the Twilight Gate in the Twilight Highlands during Up to the Citadel (Alliance).
SI:7 Operatives are humans loyal to the Alliance, guarding the way at the Alliance Beachhead to the that would take Horde players to the Vengeance Wake to rescue Thrall.

SI:7 Assassins are humans loyal to the Alliance that can be found hidden within the Savage Glen on the Lost Isles. They can only be seen while on the quest Infrared = Infradead while using the provided Infrared Heat Focals.

__NOTOC__ Sabina Pilgrim is a worgen quest ender at Thunder Peak in Ashenvale. She has come to Thunder Peak to assist the shaman of the Earthen Ring with the volcano, and the elementals around her are now her allies. She enlists the aid of Alliance adventurers to assist Arctanus, The Vortex, and Core against their fellow elemental Lord Magmathar.
SI:7 Field Commander Dirken is a human rogue found in Ragefire Chasm.
SI:7 SI:7 Commandos are humans found in Ragefire Chasm. They also appear during The Unseen Blade and capture the Shadow when they wander far away.
SI:7 Rangers are humans found in Ragefire Chasm. They are rangers of the SI:7.
__NOTOC__ SI:7 Saboteurs are found at Domination Point & Quickchop's Lumber Farm in Krasarang Wilds.
SI:7 Special Issue Facemask is a quest reward from The Dark Iron Army (Alliance).
Fired when a system message occurs. Gets displayed in the UI error frame (the default red text in the top half of the screen) in the default UI. SYSMSG: string, r, g, b
This event is fired immediately whenever you cast a spell, as well as every second while you channel spells. SPELL_UPDATE_COOLDOWN
This event is fired when a spell becomes "useable" or "unusable". SPELL_UPDATE_USABLE
Fired when the spell overlay is shown. SPELL_ACTIVATION_OVERLAY_SHOW: spellID, overlayFileDataID, locationName, scale, r, g, b
Fired when a group loot item is being rolled on. START_LOOT_ROLL: rollID, rollTime, lootHandle
Fired when a screenshot is successfully taken. SCREENSHOT_SUCCEEDED

Fired when the content of the player's skill list changes. It only fires for major changes to the list, such as learning or unlearning a skill or raising one's level from Journeyman to Master. It doesn't fire for skill rank increases. SKILL_LINES_CHANGED
Fires when the streaming client state is updated. STREAMING_ICON: streamingStatus

Fired upon receiving fancy loot (LFR, bonus rolls, containers like pet battle supplies). SHOW_LOOT_TOAST: typeIdentifier, itemLink, quantity, specID, sex, personalLootToast, toastMethod, lessAwesome, upgraded, corrupted
Fired when unable to load saved variables due to an out-of-memory error. SAVED_VARIABLES_TOO_LARGE: addOnName
Fires when a spell confirmation prompt was not accepted via or declined via within the allotted time (usually 3 minutes). SPELL_CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT: spellID, effectValue

S.H.A.R.K. was a goblin attack team that appeared from the waters during attacks. They were among the Horde forces present to strike at Lion's Landing in order to prevent the Alliance from expanding deeper into Pandaria. However despite their best efforts, S.H.A.R.K. was ultimately defeated by the Alliance.

The Sabermaw tribe or the Sabermaw clan is a group of saberon. They make their home in Sabermaw located east of in . Soulfang leads the clan from Sabermaw Den. They are known as notorious outpost raiders. They attacked merchants traveling through Nagrand.

Ryson's Eye in the Sky was an owl located in Alterac Valley. It is bound to Ryson's All Seeing Eye. It belonged to Syndicate Master Ryson, but the crystal ball was taken by the Winterax ice trolls. Once a faction completes Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye, Ryson's Beacon can be obtained. Once the beacon is placed near the enemy base, the Scrying Scope could be used to scout the battleground's areas from the viewpoint of the owl.
Fired when a channelling spell is updated. "SPELLCAST_CHANNEL_UPDATE", arg1

Fired when a spell cast stops. "SPELLCAST_STOP" * Called twice when the spell is channelled. Once at start, once at completion. * The only SURE way to determine if a non-instant, non-damaging spell is cast successfully (such as Warlock Banish) is to do the following: # Observe the spell start with UseAction or by trapping CastSpellByName() or one of the other methods of trapping spellcasts. #Wait for SPELLCAST_STOP to arrive. #When it arrives, you know the spell has stopped, but you don't know the reason!! It could be that the spell was cast successfully, or it was resisted, or the target was immune, or you moved. Schedule a success check 1/10th of a second in the future by using GetTime() a
Fired when a spellcast is begun. This event seems to work if the spell has a casting time. For instant, there is no SPELLCAST_START but SPELLCAST_STOP. "SPELLCAST_START", arg1, arg2
Fired when a spellcast is interrupted. "SPELLCAST_INTERRUPTED"
Fired when a spellcast duration is increased. "SPELLCAST_DELAYED", arg1
As of 1.10, replaces both the final SPELLCAST_CHANNEL_UPDATE (arg1==0) and SPELLCAST_STOP for channeled spells. "SPELLCAST_CHANNEL_STOP"
